emma.s: Quick idea — we're seeing ~3% of inbound leads stuck in enrichment >30s which causes round-robin to skip owners and rack up unassigned leads. Proposal: add a 'fastlane' fallback that assigns un-enriched leads after 15s to a pooled SDR queue and tag in HubSpot (fastlane=true) so CS can filter. Thoughts?
josh.k: How are we measuring "stuck" today? is that end-to-end or just enrichment svc latency?
emma.s: It's end-to-end. enrichment service reports avg 8s but tail spikes to 40-60s on image/3rd-party calls; overall we lose owner claim windows when round-robin times out.
zara.p: +1 on fastlane. We should make it opt-in per campaign, not global. Some enterprise flows require enrichment before claim.
matt.h: Can we try 15s? 10s might be aggressive and cause false fastlane. Also need a flag for salesforce-sync to avoid duplicate creates.
emma.s: Agreed opt-in per form/campaign. Fastlane rule: if enrichment not complete in Xs -> set hs property `fastlane_pending:true` and assign owner to `sdr-inbound-pool` via RR. Salesforce-sync should be aware and set lead.status = "FastlaneAssigned" to avoid duplicate lead creation.
josh.k: Can you sketch the config? I can prototype the workflow in HS test account.
emma.s: Sure — rough patch example:```yaml
hubspot_workflow:
  name: fastlane-fallback
  enabled_for_campaigns: ["website-free-trial", "ebook-download"]
  timeout_seconds: 15
  fallback_queue: "sdr-inbound-pool"
  set_property: {"fastlane_pending": "true"}
  on_assign: "annotate_source(fastlane)"
```
hubspot-bot: Workflow created in test account: fastlane-fallback (id: wf_20260322_test). :white_check_mark:
zara.p: Nice. For observability we need metrics: percent_fastlane, avg_assign_latency, and signal if owner_claim_failure_rate increases after rollout. I'll add to marketing dashboard.
matt.h: We also need a short TTL to re-run enrichment post-assign (e.g., 5m) and if enrichment completes then update owner_notes/lead_record. Avoid reassigning.
emma.s: Good call. Plan: 1) test workflow in HS sandbox 2) run 1k synthetic leads with enrichment delay sim (`/run smoke leads-sim --count 1000 --enrich-delay 40`) 3) validate SF dedupe logic and mapping 4) roll out opt-in campaigns 5) watch metrics 6) iterate.
josh.k: I ran the sim locally and saw ~2.8% fastlane at 15s with current svc tail. Sharing logs: https://internal/ci/lead-sim/2905.
emma.s: Perfect — can you create a GH ticket with test results and PR for the workflow? tag me and zara.
zara.p: I'll own rollout and dashboard. I'll add alerts: fastlane_rate > 1% on high-value campaigns -> paging to marketing oncall.
matt.h: For SF: mapping snippet we agreed on — set `Lead_Source_Detail = 'fastlane'` and `Do_Not_Reassign = true` during sync. salesforce-sync-bot: Mapping applied to sync config v3.2.1.
emma.s: Next steps: Josh creates ticket + test artifacts; I will draft help doc for SDRs explaining fastlane label and how to handle incomplete enrichment; Zara will add dashboards and alerts. If no objections, we'll start canary on website-free-trial next Tuesday. :shipit: 
josh.k: On it. PR coming later today.
zara.p: Thanks — will add to weekly launch notes and ping SDR leads. :thumbsup:
